mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, contract_project_id, assemble_config_id, process, statistics_mode, pricing_manner, measurement_manner, organization_inside_price, organization_outside_price
mapper.select: SELECT mcpgwcl.*, sac.name AS assemble_config_name, mbp.id AS process_id, mbp.name AS process_name, sas.spec_prefix AS assemble_spec_prefix FROM mes_contract_project_group_welding_config_link mcpgwcl LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config sac ON sac.id = mcpgwcl.assemble_config_id LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_spec sas ON sas.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND sas.assemble_config_id = mcpgwcl.assemble_config_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON FIND_IN_SET(mbp.id, mcpgwcl.process) > 0 WHERE mcpgwcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mcpgwcl.contract_project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT count(0) FROM mes_contract_project_group_welding_config_link mcpgwcl WHERE mcpgwcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mcpgwcl.contract_project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT mcpgwcl.*, sac.name AS assemble_config_name, mbp.id AS process_id, mbp.name AS process_name, sas.spec_prefix AS assemble_spec_prefix FROM mes_contract_project_group_welding_config_link mcpgwcl LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config sac ON sac.id = mcpgwcl.assemble_config_id LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_spec sas ON sas.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND sas.assemble_config_id = mcpgwcl.assemble_config_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON FIND_IN_SET(mbp.id, mcpgwcl.process) > 0 WHERE mcpgwcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mcpgwcl.id = #{id}
